name: You Make This House a Home
source:
You wake up in a house you don't recognize with a man you don't recognize that claims he's your lover. You can't remember a thing about your life or who you were. 
 Now you must spend the next 5 days leading up to your alleged "anniversary" exploring the house to try and find answers to your questions, or better yet, an escape.

[From [url=https://jul1xan-productions.itch.io/you-make-this-house-a-home]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个你不认识的房子里醒来，身边有一个你不认识的男人，他声称他是你的情人。你不记得你的生活或你是谁。
 现在，在所谓的“周年纪念日”之前，你必须在接下来的5天里探索这座房子，尝试找到问题的答案，或者更好的是，找到逃离的方法。

[来自[url=https://jul1xan-productions.itch.io/you-make-this-house-a-home]itch.io[/url]]
